style: cinematic 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, slapstick, deadpan
character: NARWHAL: plump speckled grey, heavy-lidded eyes, one long spiral tusk, deadpan face all clip. No neck, the tusk moves only with the whole front body. No arms, he holds nothing: props ride the tusk like a bead on a needle. He never looks at what is on it
setting: a round hole in a white ice field, open sea behind. In frame from the start: left of the hole a rusty outboard motor on its side, propeller up; right of it a big grey plastic box on its side, lid latched; on the near ice edge below a thick roll of bubble wrap, free end folded out; a grey foam mic ball on the tusk tip
lighting: polar noon, clear sky, high sun. Ice is the brightest surface, bottom third, bouncing light up under him. Pale turquoise water, the wet tusk flares a sun glint on every swing

audio.language: Russian, exactly the words in the line fields
audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice, even
audio.pacing: silent only at 2.8-3.1 and 6.4-6.7, each line runs into the next with no breath, nothing after 8.4
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, not a voice over

timeline.a: silent. He punches through and rises chest high in one shove, water sheeting off in slabs. Camera low, rising with him, one unbroken shot
the front body turns left, tusk level, the mic riding the tip like on a stand
no breath. The body rears, tusk vertical, the mic slides down it into his nose. Face unchanged
silent. One sharp nod of the whole body, the mic flies off past the lens and out for good
the tusk swings down-left, scoops the motor from below, it rolls over and slides to mid-tusk. His chest hits the edge, ice cracks
no breath. One hard swing sideways: the motor coughs a thin blue puff and sheds gears onto the ice, water slops over the edge into his face. No reaction
no breath. One long arc right: the motor flies off into the hole with a splash, the bare tip ends the same arc through the box lid, the box slides to the tusk base onto his head askew
silent. Delayed reaction: one sharp head swing, the lid unlatches and drops in the water
the box slides forward over his eyes and tips mouth down, one coin drops out, bounces off the ice and rings
no breath. The head sinks slowly to the ice with the whole body, the empty box rides forward off the tip and rolls out of frame left

silent, one move: the tusk enters the bubble wrap roll, its free end catches the tip, the body rears, the roll runs to the base laying a thick matte opaque bubble sleeve and drops off an empty tube under his chin
silent. Dead still, deadpan into the lens. Wrapped tusk, one coin on the ice

prop_continuity: the tusk carries one thing at a time, never two, and is bare between them: mic 0.0-2.8, motor 3.1-5.4, box 5.4-8.4, wrap 8.4-9.4. None returns. The coin lies on the ice from 7.0 to the last frame
must_appear: allowed: one object threaded on the tusk; a thin blue puff from the motor; gears on the ice; the box over part of his face; the tusk wrapped in thick matte opaque milky white bubble wrap, big bubbles; one coin; splash and water over his face
negative_prompt: human, hand, mic stand; two objects on the tusk at once, duplicate props, floating objects; a second narwhal, other animals, a second or broken tusk; clear, glossy or cling film; cardboard box, transparent container; smoke over the frame, fog, haze, grey sky, night, dark water, underwater; foreign accent, speech after 8.4, pauses between phrases, slow drawn-out delivery; cuts, whip pan, snap zoom, slow motion; any text, letters or numbers, subtitles, watermark
